question: Ek andheri raat mein, ek aadmi car chala raha tha. Uski car ki headlights kharab thi aur sadak ki street lights bhi band thi. Achanak sadak ke beech mein ek kaali billi (black cat) aa gayi. Aadmi ne break lagaya aur billi ko bachane ke liye car mod di. Jabki wahan koi chaand ya taare bhi nahi dikh rahe the. Aadmi ne billi ko kaise dekha?
options: Billi ki aankhein chamak rahi thi
Din ka samay tha (Sawal mein 'Raat' nahi, 'Andheri' bola hai)
Aadmi ke paas night vision tha
answer: Din ka samay tha (Sawal mein 'Raat' nahi, 'Andheri' bola hai)

question: Ek jaasoos ek barfili pahadi par bane ek round (gol) ghar mein murder mystery solve karne gaya. Wahan 3 log the: Cook, Maid, aur Butler. Victim drawing room mein mara hua tha. Cook ne kaha: 'Main kitchen mein tha'. Maid ne kaha: 'Main kono (corners) ki safai kar rahi thi'. Butler ne kaha: 'Main gate par pehra de raha tha'. Jaasoos ne Maid ko arrest kar liya. Kyun?
options: Ghar gol (round) tha, usme kone (corners) nahi hote
answer: Ghar gol (round) tha, usme kone (corners) nahi hote

question: Ek aadmi 100 feet ki oonchi seedhi (ladder) par khada tha. Achanak wo phisla aur zameen par gir gaya. Use ek kharoch tak nahi aayi aur wo uth kar chala gaya. Neeche koi gadda, paani ya net nahi tha. Ye kaise sambhav hua?
options: Wo seedhi ke sabse neeche wale dande (step) par khada tha
Seedhi hawa mein latak rahi thi
answer: Wo seedhi ke sabse neeche wale dande (step) par khada tha

question: Dhyan se suno: Ek plane America se Canada ja raha hai. Wo thik border ke upar crash ho jata hai. Malba (debris) dono deshon mein girta hai. Batao 'Survivors' (Bache hue logon) ko kahan dafnaya jayega?
answer: Survivors ko dafnaya nahi jaata

question: Ek kamre mein Romeo aur Juliet mare hue hain. Unke aas-paas thoda paani aur kaanch ke tukde hain. Kamre ki khidki khuli hai aur hawa chal rahi hai. Unke shareer par koi chot nahi hai aur na hi zeher diya gaya hai. Wo kaise mare?
options: Wo machliyan (fish) thi aur bowl toot gaya
answer: Wo machliyan (fish) thi aur bowl toot gaya

question: Ek aadmi apni car ko dhakka maar kar ek hotel ke paas le gaya. Jaise hi wo wahan pahuncha, use ehsaas hua ki wo kangal (bankrupt) ho chuka hai aur sab kuch haar gaya hai. Wo aadmi kaun hai aur kya hua?
options: Wo Monopoly game khel raha tha
Hotel maalik ne use loot liya
answer: Wo Monopoly game khel raha tha

question: Ek jadugar ek band kamre mein ek glass mein paani bharta hai. Wo us glass ko room ke beech mein rakh deta hai aur challenge karta hai ki koi bhi insaan us glass ko utha kar dikhaye. Ek pehelwan koshish karta hai par glass hilta bhi nahi. Glass chipkaya nahi gaya hai aur na hi wo bhaari hai. Jadugar ne kya kiya?
options: Jadugar ne glass ke upar koi bhari cheez rakh di thi (Invisible)
Jadugar ne pehelwan ko hypnotize kiya
answer: Jadugar ne glass ke upar koi bhari cheez rakh di thi (Invisible)

question: Mere paas shehar hain, par ghar nahi. Mere paas pahad hain, par ped nahi. Mere paas nadiyan hain, par paani nahi. Main tumhe duniya ghumata hoon bina ghar se nikle. Main kya hoon?
answer: Naksha (Map)

question: Ek aadmi Friday ko ek ghode par shahar aaya. Wo teen din wahan ruka aur Friday ko hi wapas chala gaya. Ye koi time travel nahi hai aur na hi koi jaadu. Ye kaise hua?
answer: Uske ghode ka naam 'Friday' tha

question: Ek gufa mein teen darwaze hain. Pehle darwaze ke peeche bhayankar aag hai. Dusre darwaze ke peeche hatyare hain jo bandook lekar khade hain. Teesre darwaze ke peeche sher hain jo 3 saal se bhookhe hain. Tumhe kaun sa darwaza chunna chahiye?
answer: Darwaza 3

question: Ek aadmi ne ek dukandar se 100 rupaye ka saaman kharida aur 500 ka note diya. Dukandar ke paas chutte nahi the, to wo padosi se chutte laya. Usne aadmi ko 400 wapas kiye. Thodi der baad padosi aaya aur bola ki 500 ka note nakli hai. Dukandar ko use asli 500 dene pade. Dukandar ka kul nuksan kitna hua?

Ek scientist ne ek aisi dawai banayi jo kisi bhi bimari ko theek kar sakti hai. Usne ise apne kutte par test kiya, par kutta mar gaya. Postmortem mein pata chala ki dawai kaam kar rahi thi aur kutte ko koi bimari nahi thi. Kutta kaise mara?
options: Scientist ne galti se zeher de diya
Kutta immortal ho gaya tha isliye nature ne maar diya
answer: Overdose se

question: Ek aadmi apne office mein baitha tha. Achanak light chali gayi. Usne apni drawer se ek maachis nikali aur jalane ki koshish ki, par wo nahi jali. Phir bhi wo khush ho gaya. Kyun?
options: Maachis gili thi isliye bach gaya
Wo bomb diffuse kar raha tha aur andhere mein galat wire nahi kaat paya
Uski shift khatam ho gayi thi
answer: Wo bomb diffuse kar raha tha aur andhere mein galat wire nahi kaat paya

question: Ek aadmi ne ek aurat ki tasveer ki taraf ishara karke kaha: 'Is aurat ki maa meri maa ki iklauti beti hai.' Batao wo aurat us aadmi ki kya lagti hai?
options: Beti (Lekin aadmi ki maa ki iklauti beti wo khud aadmi kaise hoga? Socho)
answer: Bhanji (Niece)

question: Ek aadmi ne ek restaurant mein 'Albatross' (ek pakshi) ka maas mangaya. Ek bite khate hi wo rone laga aur restaurant se bahar nikal kar khud ko goli maar li. Uske paas koi chithi nahi thi. Kyun?
options: Usne pehle kabhi apne bete ka maas khaya tha ye soch kar ki wo Albatross hai
Wo Albatross ko bachana chahta tha
answer: Usne pehle kabhi apne bete ka maas khaya tha ye soch kar ki wo Albatross hai

question: Do aadmi, A aur B, ek registan mein hain. A ke paas paani ki bottle hai jisme zeher hai. B ke paas paani ki bottle hai jisme ched (hole) hai. Dono pyaas se mar jaate hain. Pehle kaun marega aur kyun?
options: B pehle marega kyunki A ke paas option hai paani na peene ka
answer: B pehle marega kyunki A ke paas option hai paani na peene ka

question: Ek aadmi ne ek building ke 20th floor se chalang lagayi. Neeche koi net nahi tha, koi parachute nahi tha. Phir bhi wo zinda bach gaya aur wapas seedhiyon se upar aa gaya. Kaise?
options: Wo khidki se andar kooda tha
answer: Wo khidki se andar kooda tha

question: Ek aadmi ne apni biwi ko phone kiya aur kaha 'Main 5 minute mein ghar aa raha hoon, khana taiyar rakhna'. 5 minute baad wo ghar pahuncha to biwi mari hui thi aur khana jala hua tha. Police ne aadmi ko arrest kar liya. Kyun?
options: Aadmi ke haath mein gun thi
Aadmi ne phone dead body ke paas se kiya tha (Trace hua)
answer: Aadmi ne phone dead body ke paas se kiya tha (Trace hua)

question: Ek aadmi ek band kamre mein phansi par latka hua mila. Kamre mein koi furniture nahi tha, bas zameen par thoda paani tha. Chat (ceiling) bahut oonchi thi. Wo wahan tak kaise pahuncha?
options: Wo barf ki silli (ice block) par khada tha jo pighal gayi
answer: Wo barf ki silli (ice block) par khada tha jo pighal gayi

question: Ek chor ek museum mein ghusa. Wahan ek diamond rakha tha jiske chaaron taraf laser beams thi. Agar koi beam tootti to alarm baj jaata. Chor ne bina koi gadget use kiye, bina light band kiye diamond chura liya. Kaise?
options: Lasers visible thi par wo infrared nahi thi (Dummy)
Chor ne box ke neeche se kaat diya
answer: Chor ne box ke neeche se kaat diya

question: Ek aadmi ne ek ladki ko 'I Love You' kaha. Ladki ne jawab diya 'Main tumhari maa hoon'. Aadmi ne kaha 'Mujhe pata hai'. Ye koi incest nahi hai aur na hi wo pagal hain. Ye kaise sambhav hai?
options: Aadmi ne apni asli maa ko pehchana
answer: Wo natak (play) kar rahe the

question: Ek aadmi ne ek kitab likhi jisme ek bhi shabd nahi tha. Phir bhi wo duniya ki sabse zyada bikne wali kitab bani. Us kitab ka naam kya tha?
answer: Notebook

question: Ek aadmi ne ek building ko dhakka diya aur wo gir gayi. Ye building taash ke patton ki nahi thi aur na hi kamzor thi. Aadmi koi superhero nahi tha. Kaise?
answer: Building Domini effect se giri

question: Ek aadmi ne ek sheesha (mirror) dekha jisme kuch nahi dikh raha tha. Phir bhi wo darr gaya. Use kya dikha?
answer: Uska reflection nahi tha (Vampire)

question: Ek aadmi 8 din bina soye kaise reh sakta hai? Dhyan rahe wo koi machine ya robot nahi hai, ek aam insaan hai aur use neend ki bimari nahi hai.
answer: Wo raat ko sota hai

question: Ek aadmi ek restaurant mein gaya aur usne 'Seagull Soup' order kiya. Ek chammach peete hi wo bathroom mein gaya aur ro-ro kar apni jaan de di. Police investigation mein pata chala ki soup mein koi zeher nahi tha, aur wo aadmi mansik roop se swasth (mentally stable) tha. Usne pehle kabhi Seagull Soup nahi piya tha. To usne aisa kyun kiya?
options: Wo shipwreck survivor tha, use laga tha usne pehle Seagull khaya tha par wo asal mein uske bete ka maas tha
Soup mein uski anguthi gir gayi thi
answer: Wo shipwreck survivor tha, use laga tha usne pehle Seagull khaya tha par wo asal mein uske bete ka maas tha

question: Ek jaasoos ek band kamre mein pahuncha. Kamre mein ek table thi aur us par taash ke patte (playing cards) bikhre hue the. Zameen par 53 bicycles (cycles) padi thi aur ek laash thi. Kamre mein aur kuch nahi tha. Jaasoos ne dekhte hi kaha: 'Ye cheating ka mamla hai'. Ye kaise sambhav hai?
options: Bicycles 'Bicycle' brand ke playing cards the
Laash ke paas cycle ki chain thi
answer: Bicycles 'Bicycle' brand ke playing cards the

question: Do aadmi, A aur B, ek registan (desert) mein phas gaye. Unke paas pani nahi tha. A ne B ko goli maar di. Phir bhi, court ne A ko bari kar diya aur kaha ki ye self-defense nahi tha, balki ye 'Dayalu Hatya' (Mercy Killing) thi. Court ne aisa kyun kaha?
options: B ne A se kaha tha mujhe maar do taaki main pyaas se na tadpun
answer: B ne A se kaha tha mujhe maar do taaki main pyaas se na tadpun

question: Ek aadmi apne office se nikalta hai aur ghar ki taraf chalta hai. Raste mein barish shuru ho jati hai. Uske paas na chhatri hai, na topi, aur na hi koi hood. Uske kapde puri tarah bheeg jate hain, lekin uska ek bhi baal gila nahi hota. Wo gadi mein nahi tha aur na hi kisi chhat ke neeche. Kaise?
options: Baarish bahut dheere ho rahi thi
answer: Wo ganja (bald) tha

question: Ek aadmi ne ek antique shop se ek purani bottle kharidi. Bottle par likha tha 'Isme kaid jinn tumhari ek khwaish puri karega'. Aadmi ne dhakkan khola, jinn bahar aaya, par aadmi mar gaya. Jinn ne use nahi mara aur na hi aadmi darr se mara. To kya hua?
options: Bottle mein zeherili gas thi jo sadiyon se band thi
Jinn ne oxygen khatam kar di
answer: Bottle mein zeherili gas thi jo sadiyon se band thi

question: Ek aadmi subah uthta hai, brush karta hai, kapde pehanta hai aur breakfast karne baithta hai. Jaise hi wo pehla nivala (bite) leta hai, use ehsaas hota hai ki wo aaj marne wala hai. Khane mein zeher nahi hai aur wo bimar nahi hai. Use kaise pata chala?
options: Usne newspaper mein apni maut ki khabar (Obituary) padhi (Galti se chhap gayi thi)
Uska sapna sach ho raha tha
Ghar ke bahar police khadi thi
answer: Usne newspaper mein apni maut ki khabar (Obituary) padhi (Galti se chhap gayi thi)

question: Ek aadmi ne ek ladki ko kidnap kiya aur use ek soundproof basement mein band kar diya. Ladki ke paas phone nahi tha, internet nahi tha. Phir bhi usne police ko bula liya bina darwaza khole aur bina shor machaye. Kaise?
options: Usne 'Pizza Order' app se 911 ke liye pizza order kiya (Comments mein 'Help' likha)
Wo cheekhi aur padosi ne sun liya
answer: Usne 'Pizza Order' app se 911 ke liye pizza order kiya (Comments mein 'Help' likha)

question: Ek aadmi 7th floor par rehta hai. Wo roz subah lift se neeche ground floor par jata hai aur kaam par jata hai. Sham ko jab wo wapas aata hai, to agar barish ho rahi ho ya lift mein aur log hon, to wo seedha 7th floor par jata hai. Warna wo 5th floor par utarta hai aur baaki 2 floor seedhiyon se jata hai. Kyun?
options: Wo naata (dwarf) hai aur 7th button tak nahi pahunch pata (Umbrella se pahunchta hai)
Lift 5th floor tak hi jaati hai
answer: Wo naata (dwarf) hai aur 7th button tak nahi pahunch pata (Umbrella se pahunchta hai)

question: Ek aadmi ne ek building ke 30th floor ki khidki kholi aur bahar kood gaya. Neeche zameen pakki thi, koi safety net nahi tha. Phir bhi use kuch nahi hua aur wo wapas andar aa gaya. Kaise?
options: Wo khidki se 'andar' ki taraf kooda (floor par)
Khidki zameen se sirf 1 foot upar thi
Wo gravity control kar sakta tha
answer: Wo khidki se 'andar' ki taraf kooda (floor par)

question: Ek kamre mein ek laash latki hui hai. Kamre ka darwaza andar se lock hai. Khidkiyan band hain. Kamre mein koi furniture nahi hai, na koi stool, na kursi. Zameen par sirf pani ka ek bada ghera (puddle) hai. Aadmi ne khudkushi kaise ki?
options: Wo ek bade barf ke block (Ice slab) par khada tha jo pighal gaya
answer: Wo ek bade barf ke block (Ice slab) par khada tha jo pighal gaya

question: Ek aadmi ne ek aurat ki photo khechi. Photo develop hone par aurat ka chehra gayab tha, lekin uske kapde aur background saaf dikh rahe the. Camera digital nahi tha aur na hi photo edit ki gayi thi. Aurat wahi khadi thi. Ye kaise hua?
options: Aurat ne burqa pehna tha jo background se match kar gaya
Aurat bahut tezi se hil rahi thi (Motion blur)
answer: Aurat Vampire thi (No reflection/image)

question: Ek aadmi car chala raha hai. Usne radio on kiya. Radio par gaana band hua aur news aayi. News sunte hi aadmi ne car roka aur khud ko goli maar li. News mein kya tha?
options: 'Jish ship par aapki family thi wo doob gayi'
'Police ne aapki pehchan kar li hai'
answer: 'Jish ship par aapki family thi wo doob gayi'

question: Ek aadmi ne ek dukandar se kaha: 'Agar main tumhe ek aisa naya shabd bataun jo aaj tak kisi ne nahi suna, to kya tum mujhe ye samaan free mein doge?' Dukandar maan gaya. Aadmi ne kaun sa shabd bola?
answer: Koi bhi random aawaz

question: Ek aadmi ne ek machli pakdi. Machli ne kaha 'Mujhe mat khao, main tumhe 3 vardan dungi'. Aadmi ne kaha 'Theek hai' aur machli ko wapas pani mein daal diya. Machli doob gayi aur mar gayi. Kaise?
options: Wo machli nahi, ek 'Land Animal' tha jo machli jaisa dikhta tha
Machli ko heart attack aa gaya
answer: Wo machli nahi, ek 'Land Animal' tha jo machli jaisa dikhta tha

question: Ek aadmi ne ek building kharidi. Agle din wo building gayab ho gayi. Police ne investigation ki to pata chala ki building chori nahi hui, na hi tuti, na hi zameen mein dhasi. Building wahi thi par dikh nahi rahi thi. Kaise?
options: Wo ek 'Mobile Home' (Caravan) tha jo chala gaya
Building mirrors (sheeshe) se dhaki thi (Invisibility illusion)
answer: Building mirrors (sheeshe) se dhaki thi (Invisibility illusion)

question: Ek aadmi ne ek ladki ko kiss kiya. Ladki ne thappad maara. Aadmi ne maafi maangi aur kaha 'Sorry, mujhe laga tum meri biwi ho'. Ladki ne phir thappad maara. Kyun?
options: Kyunki wo uski biwi hi thi
Ladki ko laga wo jhooth bol raha hai
answer: Kyunki wo uski biwi hi thi

question: Ek aadmi ne ek glass doodh piya aur mar gaya. Doodh mein zeher nahi tha, doodh kharab nahi tha, aadmi ko allergy nahi thi. To maut kaise hui?
options: Glass toot gaya aur wo kaanch nigal gaya
Gay (Cow) ne use maara tha jab wo doodh nikal raha tha
Aadmi ne doodh naak se piya aur fefdo mein chala gaya
answer: Glass toot gaya aur wo kaanch nigal gaya

question: Ek aadmi ne ek kutta kharida. Dukandar ne kaha 'Ye kutta kabhi nahi bhaukta'. Aadmi khush ho gaya. 2 din baad aadmi ne dukandar par case kar diya kyunki kutta bhaukta nahi tha par wo aadmi ko pasand nahi aaya. Kyun?
options: Kutta goonga nahi, behra tha aur sun nahi sakta tha
answer: Kutta rota bahut tha

question: Ek aadmi ne ek bandook saaf ki aur galti se chala di. Goli seedha uske dost ke dil par lagi. Dost gira, par mara nahi. Uthi aur bola 'Dhyan se yaar'. Dost Superman nahi tha aur na hi usne bulletproof vest pehni thi. Kaise bacha?
options: Goli sheeshe (mirror) mein lage dost ke reflection par lagi thi
Dost ka dil right side mein tha
answer: Goli sheeshe (mirror) mein lage dost ke reflection par lagi thi

question: Ek aadmi ne ek building ke 15th floor se chalang lagayi. Raste mein use ek phone aaya. Usne phone uthaya, baat ki, aur zameen par girne se pehle phone rakh diya. Girne ke baad wo zinda tha. Kaise?
answer: Wo 'Bungee Jumping' kar raha tha

question: Ek aadmi ne ek kitab likhi jisme koi kahani nahi thi, koi gyaan nahi tha, bas blank pages the. Phir bhi wo kitab duniya ki har library mein hai aur log use roz kharidte hain. Kitab ka naam kya hai?
answer: Notebook / Diary

question: Ek aadmi ne ek ladki ko phone kiya. Ladki ne phone uthaya aur kaha 'Wrong Number'. Aadmi ne kaha 'Thank you' aur khushi-khushi phone rakh diya. Aadmi stalker nahi tha. To wo khush kyun hua?
options: Wo check kar raha tha ki uska phone kaam kar raha hai ya nahi
Wo apni biwi ko phone kar raha tha aur confirm karna chahta tha ki wo ghar par hai ya nahi (Aawaz se pehchan liya)
Usne galat number hi milaya tha
answer: Wo check kar raha tha ki uska phone kaam kar raha hai ya nahi

question: Ek aadmi ne ek sheesha toda. 7 saal baad uski shaadi hui. Log kehte hain sheesha todne se 7 saal ki badkismati hoti hai. Kya is case mein ye sach hua?
options: Haan, kyunki shaadi hi badkismati thi (Joke riddle)
answer: Haan, kyunki shaadi hi badkismati thi (Joke riddle)

question: Ek aadmi 10 din bina khaye raha aur mar gaya. Dusra aadmi 10 din bina khaye raha aur uska wazan badh gaya. Kaise?
options: Dusra aadmi raat mein khata tha
Dusra aadmi paani bahut peeta tha (Water retention)
Dusra aadmi jhooth bol raha tha
answer: Dusra aadmi raat mein khata tha

question: Ek aadmi ne ek bakri ko sher ke pinjre mein dala. Sher ne use nahi khaya. Sher bimar nahi tha aur na hi mara hua tha. Bakri bhi asli thi. Kyun?
options: Sher ka pet bhara hua tha
answer: Sher ka pet bhara hua tha

question: Ek aadmi apne ghar ki light band karke so jata hai. Agle din wo news dekhta hai ki ek jahaj (ship) doob gaya aur saikdon log mar gaye. Wo aadmi rote hue khud ko goli maar leta hai. Kyun?
options: Wo Lighthouse Keeper tha (Light band hone se jahaj takra gaya)
Wo jahaj ka Captain tha jo ghar aa gaya tha
Uski family us jahaj par thi
Usne sapne mein jahaj doobte dekha tha
answer: Wo Lighthouse Keeper tha (Light band hone se jahaj takra gaya)

question: Ek jale hue jungle ke beech mein ek aadmi ki laash milti hai. Aadmi ne Scuba Diving suit pehna hua hai, oxygen tank lagaya hai aur pairon mein flippers hain. Jungle samundar se 50 km door hai. Ye aadmi wahan kaise pahuncha aur kaise mara?
options: Aag bujhane wale plane ne use galti se paani ke saath utha liya aur jungle mein gira diya
Wo jungle mein nadi dhoond raha tha
answer: Aag bujhane wale plane ne use galti se paani ke saath utha liya aur jungle mein gira diya

question: Ek aadmi ne ek restaurant mein khana khaya. Waiter ne bill diya. Aadmi ne bill par kuch likha aur waiter ko de diya. Waiter ne police ko bula liya. Aadmi ke paas paise the aur usne gali-galoch bhi nahi ki thi. To police kyun aayi?
options: Aadmi ne napkin par 'Help me, I'm kidnapped' likha tha
answer: Aadmi ne napkin par 'Help me, I'm kidnapped' likha tha

question: Ek aadmi railway patri par leta hua hai. Wo train ke aane ka intezar kar raha hai taaki wo mar sake. Train aati hai, uske upar se guzar jaati hai, par wo aadmi marta nahi hai. Wo patri ke beech mein hi leta tha aur train puri speed mein thi. Kaise?
options: Aadmi patri ke neeche gaddhe mein tha
Train patri par nahi, upar (Metro/Monorail) thi
answer: Train patri par nahi, upar (Metro/Monorail) thi

question: Ek aadmi subah uthta hai aur dekhta hai ki uske ghar ke bahar lakdi ka buraada (sawdust) pada hai. Wo turant suicide kar leta hai. Wo aadmi circus mein kaam karta tha aur duniya ka sabse chota (shortest) aadmi tha. Usne suicide kyun kiya?
options: Use laga wo lamba ho raha hai (naukri jane ka darr)
Kisi ne uski walking stick kaat di thi (use laga wo andha ho gaya)
Use laga deemak (termites) ghar kha gaye
Uski lakdi ki taang toot gayi thi
answer: Kisi ne uski walking stick kaat di thi (use laga wo andha ho gaya)

question: Ek aadmi car mein baitha hai aur apne pairon par goli maar leta hai. Car ka darwaza lock hai aur khidkiyan band hain. Bahar koi nahi hai. Usne aisa kyun kiya?
options: Wo check kar raha tha gun asli hai ya nahi
Wo car mein phans gaya tha aur dhyan khichne ke liye goli chalayi
Galti se trigger dab gaya (Bump aane par)
Wo insurance fraud karna chahta tha
answer: Galti se trigger dab gaya (Bump aane par)

question: Ek aurat ne apne husband ke liye coffee banayi. Husband ne ek sip li aur mar gaya. Aurat ne wahi coffee pi par use kuch nahi hua. Coffee mein zeher nahi tha, cup mein zeher nahi tha. Husband ko allergy bhi nahi thi. Husband kaise mara?
options: Husband ki muchh (moustache) par zeher laga tha
Husband ne dawai khaayi thi jo react kar gayi
Husband ne sugar ki jagah kuch aur daal diya tha
answer: Husband ki muchh (moustache) par zeher laga tha

question: Ek aadmi ne ek building ke 50th floor se chalang lagayi. Usne parachute pehna hua tha, par wo khula nahi. Wo zameen par gira, par mara nahi, sirf pair toota. Ye kaise hua?
options: Wo building ke andar 'Safety Net' par gira
Uska parachute 'Bag' tha, asli parachute nahi
answer: Wo 'Snow' (Barf) ke dher par gira

question: Ek aadmi apne dost ke ghar jata hai. Wahan table par taash ke patte (cards) bikhre hue hain aur dost mara hua hai. Aadmi turant police ko phone karta hai aur kehta hai: 'Mere dost ko kisi ne dhokhe se maara hai'. Police aati hai aur aadmi ko arrest kar leti hai. Kyun?
options: Aadmi ne gun wahin chod di thi
Dost ke haath mein '5 Aces' the (Jo cheating ka saboot hai, par sirf khelne wale ko pata hoga)
Aadmi ke kapdon par khoon tha
